description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Edmentum develops technology-enabled learning solutions for educators and students. The Software Engineer I helps build and maintain product software by implementing and testing features, contributing to deployments and production support, and collaborating with engineering and product teammates.
Software Engineer I building and maintaining software features, writing tests, deploying through CI/CD, and troubleshooting production issues

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain software features and fixes within established architecture, with guidance from senior engineers
• Write clean, maintainable code along with unit and integration tests that help your team ship with confidence
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile ceremonies, applying feedback to grow your skills
• Deploy your work through CI/CD pipelines and help troubleshoot production issues, escalating when needed
• Collaborate with teammates and product partners to clarify requirements and share progress
• Actively learn our codebase and products and adopt new engineering practices as AI-assisted and agentic development changes how we work
• Keep documentation current so others can understand and support your work

Requirements:
• Candidates must have experience with .NET and Angular
• You embrace AI/agentic assisted development backed by context engineering and promote AI-first workflows across the full software delivery lifecycle
• You use AI to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering work while applying technical judgment, critical evaluation, and debugging skills to validate, challenge, and refine AI-generated recommendations and outputs
• You have working knowledge of C# and .NET or another object-oriented language, and you're excited to learn our stack
• You've written real code through professional work, internships, coursework, bootcamps, or personal projects
• You understand the value of automated testing and have written unit tests
• You're familiar with version control (Git), relational databases, and agile development practices
• You're curious and ask questions to understand the "why," not just the "how." You welcome feedback and use it to grow
• You communicate clearly and work well on a collaborative, remote team
• You are committed to inclusive practices, collaborative teamwork, and making Edmentum's engineering organization a place where everyone can thrive
• You hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience, and bring 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience
• You are willing to take on evolving responsibilities based on business needs

Preferred:
• Exposure to Angular or another front-end framework, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms like AWS is a plus
